protocol.primary_training: Hanson positives and assumed negatives only
protocol.primary_scoring: Hanson only, before last n=1 onset; no verified negatives
protocol.broad_sensitivity: same predictions; post-last-onset and n=2-only negatives added
protocol.high_beta: beta_N >= 0.8 times each shot's whole-window p95 (evaluation only)
protocol.time_baseline: elapsed since first |Ip| >= 0.5 MA; fixed causal start proxy
protocol.alarm_tuning: threshold grid from primary negatives; alarm objective over full inner-OOF Hanson traces; comparison shots never tune alarms
protocol.nnpu: excluded: outer-fold-informed development and unidentified U prior
protocol.rotation_claim: removed; no isolated rotation benefit claimed
protocol.interval_scope: shot sampling at fixed fitted OOF predictions; split sensitivity separate
